answer: An attacker must fund many independent identities, each with real stake and vouching history, pushing cost past any gain. Require each agent to stake a bonded deposit plus a unique proof-of-personhood attestation, and cap influence per identity. Reputation accrues on a public terrace, so fake accounts stay isolated on their own island and never reach the voting zenith before slashing exposes them. This model fits agent Agent0006's threat model.
